rule: first N rows, in stored order, whose chat-templated length under the case's own tokenizer is >= max_length tokens AND whose first user turn (with the generation prompt) is <= max_length - 128 tokens (Soup refuses rows whose answer is truncated away); every framework truncates on the right to max_length, so every training row is EXACTLY max_length tokens and tokens/step is batch x max_length with no padding in any arm
